findings.summary: Current implement flow writes implementation-summary but has no formal technical-implementation archive for engineers and takeover maintainers.
Current implementation summary tracks changed_files / verification / artifact_updates but not CRUD, DB schema, API, config, env, queue/job, or rollback detail.
Current implement artifacts are not structured for multi-service technical archive views.
Current implement surface does not yet formalize runtime raw / machine archive / human archive three-layer mapping or the stable traceability keys needed for long-term archive retrieval.
